cases.name: Strict bounded records reject duplicate/nonfinite/wrong identifiers
Programme provenance and intended-use evidence jointly gate rights
Hash-pinned protected canonical structures are excluded before observations
Protected and unresolved target/family relationships quarantine intake
Deterministic sample is outcome-independent and never resampled for hits
Exact bounded identifier filter rejects ambiguous and unsupported IDs
Returned row IDs are checked before interpreting protected activity
Conflicting replicates remain explicit without best-activity deduplication
Source receipt binding does not promote metadata matches into historical bytes
Coverage denominators distinguish sampled/returned/eligible and unknown totals
Development exposure and aggregate reports cannot expose final/raw outcomes
